critical_code_review_comments: Bridge close delay of 12000ms is at the top end of user tolerance; if the server self-heal typically completes in <10s this is fine, but if a user closes the popup manually they still wait 12s for programmatic close — acceptable trade-off given the >=10000ms explicit requirement.

Background repo-sync polls every 5s for up to 2 minutes; if repos never populate within 2min the user is silently left with an empty banner picker unless they refresh — consider surfacing a 'still syncing' state on the banner after cap (only wizard has this today).
